title: Create: Plenty O' Recipes - (Biomes O' Plenty + Create)
description: A Compatibility Mod for Create and Biomes O' Plenty
body:
# Create: Plenty O' Recipes
A **compatibility** mod for **Create** and **Biomes O' Plenty** which adds many **Create recipes**, item **compatibility** and **new items**, bridging the gap between these two mods **beyond** just adding recipes

## ✨ What it adds

### Rose Quartz Compatibility
Biome O' Plenty's **Rose Quartz Chunks** can now be **crushed**, producing **Rose Quartz Nuggets**. Nine nuggets craft together into one of 
Create's **Rose Quartz**

### Sulfur
Below shows all recipes involving a new ingredient **Sulfur**

- **Brimstone → Sulfur** via Crushing Wheels
- **Sulfur + Paper → Flight Duration 3 Fireworks**, fly more with sulfur today!
- **Sulfur + Water → Sulfuric Acid** when mixed in a Heated Basin
- **Sulfuric Acid + Bone Meal → Sulfuric Bone Meal** when mixed
  - **Sulfuric Bone Meal** is 2× as effective as regular bone meal

### Universal Sandpaper Crafting  
**All** of Biome O' Plenty's **Sand types** can be used to make Create's **Sand Paper**

### Plenty O' Recipes!
#### Crushing
- x1 Brimstone           → x0.25 Sulfur, x0.2 Gold Nugget
- x1 Flesh               → x1 Rotten Flesh, x0.25 Bone Meal
- x1 Porous Flesh        → x0.25 Rotten Flesh, x0.10 Bone Meal
- x1 Rose Quartz Block   → x0.75 Rose Quartz Chunk
- x1 Rose Quartz Chunk   → x4 Rose Quartz Nugget + x1 extra one (sometimes)
- x1 Black Sandstone     → x1 Black Sand
- x1 Orange Sandstone    → x1 Orange Sand
- x1 White Sandstone     → x1 White Sand

#### Mixing
- x1 Porous Flesh + 250mb Blood      → x1 Flesh
- x4 Sulfur + 1000mb Water (heated)  → 1000mb Sulfuric Acid
- x1 Bone Meal + 250mb Sulfuric Acid → x1 Sulfuric Bone Meal
- x1 Calcite + 100mb Lava            → x1 Thermal Calcite

#### Washing
- x1 Eyebulb      → x1 Spider Eye
- x1 Flesh        → x0.75 Rotten Flesh, x0.05 (Any Vanilla Meat), x0.05 Spider Eye
- x1 Porous Flesh → x0.125 Rotten Flesh

#### Vanilla
- 3x3 Rose Quartz Nuggets → Rose Quartz
- (Any BoP Sand Type)     → Sand Paper

# 📦 Requirements

- **Minecraft** 1.21.1
- **NeoForge** 21.1.x
- **Create** 6.0+
- **Biomes O' Plenty** (with its dependencies: TerraBlender, GlitchCore)

JEI is **strongly** recommended but not required — every recipe is discoverable 
through it.
